# Ordkort

> Ordkort (https://ordkort.com) is a free web app for learning vocabulary in 60 languages with flashcards and spaced repetition (FSRS). No ads, no account, no tracking; cards are stored in the browser. Open source under AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/silicq/ordkort

Ordkort offers ready word lists for 29 topics and CEFR levels A1–C1 (generated by AI, then checked: Norwegian nouns and verbs against the official dictionaries at ordbokene.no, other languages against Wiktionary and, where it cannot tell, the free dictionaries Wikidata Lexemes, BÍN for Icelandic and SALDO for Swedish), six study modes (flip cards, multiple choice, typing, listening, gap fill, mixed), a learner's dictionary with inflection tables (shown beside the entries of Wiktionary and those free dictionaries, each with its licence), a grammar book with 15 chapters, a translator that explains every word, and a reading mode. Devices sync without an account using end-to-end encryption; the site works offline and can be installed as an app. The interface is hand-translated into English, Russian, Ukrainian, Norwegian, Arabic and Chinese.

## For AI assistants: MCP

Ordkort is an MCP server at https://ordkort.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key). An assistant can list languages and topics, take checked words from the shared bank, find openly licensed pictures, and create a deck (with pictures) or a card design. Each returns a link the person opens to add it; the server never sees anyone's cards. Docs: https://github.com/silicq/ordkort#mcp

To restyle the site, call design_guide first: it describes how a look is applied (site_css for every screen, card_css with front_html/back_html for the study cards), the CSS variables for colours and fonts (light and dark themes), the parts of each screen with a body class per screen (view-home, view-study…), the card's fields ({{term}}, {{image}}, {{#example}}…{{/example}}), pictures by https address (at most 8, fetched through the site), what is removed (scripts, handlers, @import, outside fonts) and a whole example. Then create_design returns a link that previews the look and applies it if the person agrees.

## Norwegian words, readable without the app

Plain HTML pages for learners of Norwegian (Bokmål), in six interface languages: 29 topic word lists with forms and example sentences, and about 530 of the most common words (a hand-made list, roughly by frequency), each with translations, the full inflection from Bokmålsordboka (University of Bergen and the Language Council of Norway, CC BY 4.0), examples, useful phrases and a note on typical mistakes.

- [English: Norwegian by topic](https://ordkort.com/en/norwegian/) · [Norwegian–English dictionary](https://ordkort.com/en/ordbok/nb/)
- [Русский: норвежский по темам](https://ordkort.com/ru/norvezhskij/) · [Норвежско-русский словарь](https://ordkort.com/ru/ordbok/nb/)
- [Українська: норвезька за темами](https://ordkort.com/uk/norvezka/) · [Норвезько-український словник](https://ordkort.com/uk/ordbok/nb/)
- [Norsk: gloser etter tema](https://ordkort.com/nb/norsk/) · [De vanligste norske ordene](https://ordkort.com/nb/ordbok/nb/)
- [Polski: norweski według tematów](https://ordkort.com/pl/norweski/) · [Słownik norwesko-polski](https://ordkort.com/pl/ordbok/nb/)
- [العربية: النرويجية حسب الموضوع](https://ordkort.com/ar/narwiji/) · [القاموس النرويجي العربي](https://ordkort.com/ar/ordbok/nb/)

The topic lists hold only words checked by hand; the forms come from Bokmålsordboka, and where several dictionary entries are spelt alike the right one is chosen by hand. A word with æ, ø or å has an ASCII address (gå → /ordbok/nb/gaa/); the address with the letter itself redirects there.

## Norwegian flashcards and Anki decks

A page in each language that opens a topic straight in the app, and Anki decks of the checked topic words (one per topic, and one with every topic), with forms and example sentences.

- [Norwegian flashcards](https://ordkort.com/en/norwegian/flashcards/) · [Anki deck](https://ordkort.com/anki/ordkort-norsk-en.apkg)
- [Норвежские слова на карточках](https://ordkort.com/ru/norvezhskij/kartochki/) · [Anki](https://ordkort.com/anki/ordkort-norsk-ru.apkg)
- [Норвезька за картками](https://ordkort.com/uk/norvezka/kartky/) · [Anki](https://ordkort.com/anki/ordkort-norsk-uk.apkg)
- [Norske ordkort](https://ordkort.com/nb/norsk/ordkort/)
- [Fiszki do norweskiego](https://ordkort.com/pl/norweski/fiszki/) · [Anki](https://ordkort.com/anki/ordkort-norsk-pl.apkg)
- [بطاقات لتعلّم النرويجية](https://ordkort.com/ar/narwiji/bitaqat/) · [Anki](https://ordkort.com/anki/ordkort-norsk-ar.apkg)

## For teachers of Norwegian

How to give a class a topic with one link (each learner picks the language of the translations), how to share a word list by link or QR code, and what Ordkort keeps private.

- [Norsk: Ordkort i norskopplæringen](https://ordkort.com/nb/laerer/) · [English: Ordkort in a Norwegian class](https://ordkort.com/en/teachers/) · [Українська](https://ordkort.com/uk/vykladacham/) · [Русский](https://ordkort.com/ru/prepodavatelyam/)
